scope: Verify all five responsive radius Inspector fields through mobile Canvas, draft Save, Editor reload, explicit Publish and inheritance reset for all 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types.

initial_regression.result: The first test run completed mobile Save and Publish, then failed when the fixture compared the Editor Canvas reset value to the different public class-based desktop border radius on a section node.
initial_regression.classification: Test assertion used the wrong baseline; no application defect. The fixture now records desktop Canvas and public CSS values separately.

coverage: All 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types expose radius.all plus radius.topLeft, radius.topRight, radius.bottomRight and radius.bottomLeft through their exact responsive.set commands and Page Model keys.
Distinct mobile values for all five radius fields render on Canvas and persist in the matching mobile Page Model fields after draft Save.
Draft Save leaves published mobile CSS unchanged; every field survives Editor reload.
Explicit Publish applies the expected computed mobile all-corner and individual-corner values for all 44 types.
Mobile Publish leaves all four desktop public corner-radius values unchanged.
Resetting all five mobile radius fields restores desktop Canvas inheritance; reset Save leaves published mobile CSS unchanged; separate Publish restores public desktop inheritance on mobile.
Canvas breakpoint baselines and public CSS baselines are measured independently for each type.
